scope: Final Markdown Python and R examples executed for remote, discovery/schema, download and local modes. Standalone SQL executed with Python DuckDB. Registry fixture supplied through isolated Python cache / R registry option. Default URL separately returned 16 entries without the additions. Constructors bounded to 128MiB/one thread/no spill; INSTALL replaced with LOAD of preinstalled httpfs. No software installed. Python Hugging Face optional dependency is absent, so download used the immutable requests fallback. No claim that a different default shell import or current source checkout was tested.
